items.title: Mark Soskin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 17, 2021
items.q: I’m fond of the Cannonball Adderley story where he shows up in New York and sits in with Oscar Pettiford

ctx.x: Well I don’t think anybody could just go out there and get a record date, but somehow I’ve managed to do that.
The days of, like I’m fond of the Cannonball Adderley story where he shows up in New York and sits in with Oscar Pettiford and next thing you know he’s got a record contract.
I mean because I played with Sonny Rollins, that’s a good reason why I got a record contract.
